name: bring-my-gui
description: Forward a GUI app from a headless Linux sandbox (Docker container, agent sbx) to your host screen over VNC, and finish its browser login from the host. Covers the Xvfb + openbox + x11vnc stack, HiDPI scaling, clipboard, non-Latin keyboard input, and an OAuth bridge that captures the URL a desktop app (Cursor, Claude, Electron, VS Code) tries to open so you sign in on your own machine.
